verses.geez: ወእደ፡ ተናገረ፡ ሳፍር፡ አሜናዊ፡ ተሠጥወ።
verses.translation: Then Sophar the Minæan answered and said,

translations.lxx: Then Sophar the Minæan answered and said,
translations.kjv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
translations.ron: Şi Ţofar din Naamah a început să vorbească şi a zis:

verses.geez: ወይቤ፡ ኢሐዘብኩከ፡ ትንብብ፡ ዘከመዝ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘትኄይስ፡ እምኔየ፡ አእምሮ።
verses.translation: I did not suppose that thou wouldest answer thus: neither do ye understand more than I.

translations.lxx: I did not suppose that thou wouldest answer thus: neither do ye understand more than I.
translations.kjv: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.
translations.ron: "Cugetul meu mă împinge să vorbesc, din pricina frământării pe care o simt în mine.

verses.geez: ስምዓኒ፡ እንግርከ፡ ጥበበ፡ ትምህርትየ፡ ወጣወሥአኒ፡ መንፈሰ፡ ሕሊናየ።
verses.translation: I will hear my shameful reproach; and the spirit of my understanding answers me.

translations.lxx: I will hear my shameful reproach; and the spirit of my understanding answers me.
translations.kjv: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
translations.ron: Am auzit o învăţătură care mă scoate din sărite şi atunci o pornire vijelioasă, din duhul meu, mă face să răspund.

verses.geez: ቦኑ፡ ዘተአምር፡ ዘከመዝ፡ እምቅድሜሁ፡ ወእምእሜከ፡ ወእምድኅሬከ፡ ወእምእመ፡ ተፈጥረ፡ ዓለም።
verses.translation: Hast thou not known these things of old, from the time that man was set upon the earth?

translations.lxx: Hast thou not known these things of old, from the time that man was set upon the earth?
translations.kjv: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
translations.ron: Nu ştii tu oare că de mult de tot, din zilele când omul a fost aşezat pe pământ,

verses.geez: ፍሥሓሆሙ፡ ለኃጥአን፡ ቀትል፡ ዓቢይ፡ ወኃሤቶሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ኅጕል።
verses.translation: But the mirth of the ungodly is a signal downfall, and the joy of transgressors is destruction:

translations.lxx: But the mirth of the ungodly is a signal downfall, and the joy of transgressors is destruction:
translations.kjv: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?
translations.ron: Desfătarea celor fără de lege ţine foarte puţin şi bucuria făţarnicului nu stă decât o clipă?

verses.geez: ወአመ፡ ይቤ፡ ወዳእኩ፡ ጻናዕኩ፡ እሜሃ፡ ይትሐጐል፡ ለዝሉፉ፡ ወይብሉ፡ እለ፡ የአምርዎ፡ አይቴ፡ ሀሎ።
verses.translation: although his gifts should go up to heaven, and his sacrifice reach the clouds.

translations.lxx: although his gifts should go up to heaven, and his sacrifice reach the clouds.
translations.kjv: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
translations.ron: Chiar dacă statura lui s-ar înălţa până la ceruri şi cu capul s-ar atinge de nori,

verses.geez: እመኒ፡ ዓርገ፡ ሰማየ፡ ቊርባኑ፡ ወበጽሐ፡ እስከ፡ ደመና፡ መሥዋዕቱ።
verses.translation: For when he shall seem to be now established, then he shall utterly perish: and they that knew him shall say, Where is he?

translations.lxx: For when he shall seem to be now established, then he shall utterly perish: and they that knew him shall say, Where is he?
translations.kjv: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?
translations.ron: El totuşi va pieri ca o nălucă, pe vecie, şi cei ce îl vedeau vor întreba: Ce s-a făcut?

verses.geez: ወሠረረ፡ ከመ፡ ሐልዎ፡ ወኢትረከብ፡ ወያስተርኢ፡ ከመ፡ ሕልመ፡ ሌሊተ፡ ዘኢይትዓወቅ፡ ወይመስል፡ ጽባሐ።
verses.translation: Like a dream that has fled away, he shall not be found; and he has fled like a vision of the night.

translations.lxx: Like a dream that has fled away, he shall not be found; and he has fled like a vision of the night.
translations.kjv: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
translations.ron: Zboară ca un vis şi nu mai dai de el, e măturat ca o vedenie de noapte.

verses.geez: ወርእዮቶ፡ ዓይን፡ ኢትጸግብ፡ እንከ፡ ወዚየአምር፡ እንከ፡ መካኖ።
verses.translation: The eye has looked upon him, but shall not see him again; and his place shall no longer perceive him.

translations.lxx: The eye has looked upon him, but shall not see him again; and his place shall no longer perceive him.
translations.kjv: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
translations.ron: Ochiul, care îl privea, nu-l mai vede şi locul unde se găsea, nu-l mai zăreşte.

verses.geez: ወታጠፍእዎሙ፡ ለውሉዱ፡ ትሑታን፡ ወእደዊሁኒ፡ እሳተ፡ ይነፍሓ።
verses.translation: Let his inferiors destroy his children, and let his hands kindle the fire of sorrow.

translations.lxx: Let his inferiors destroy his children, and let his hands kindle the fire of sorrow.
translations.kjv: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
translations.ron: Feciorii lui vor trebui să cerşească mila celor săraci şi mâinile lui vor da înapoi ce a luat cu forţa.

verses.geez: ወይመልእ፡ ፃዕር፡ ውስተ፡ አዕፅምቲሁ፡ ወጥሰክብ፡ ሕማሙ፡ ውስተ፡ መሬት።
verses.translation: His bones have been filled with vigour of his youth, and it shall lie down with him in the dust.

translations.lxx: His bones have been filled with vigour of his youth, and it shall lie down with him in the dust.
translations.kjv: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
translations.ron: Oasele lui sunt încă pline de vlaga tinereţii, dar ea se va culca cu el în pulbere;

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ጥዕመቶ፡ አኪት፡ ውስተ፡ አፍሁ፡ ወየኃብኣ፡ ታሕተ፡ ልሳኑ።
verses.translation: Though evil be sweet in his mouth, though he will hide it under his tongue;

translations.lxx: Though evil be sweet in his mouth, though he will hide it under his tongue;
translations.kjv: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;
translations.ron: Dacă răutatea este dulce în gura lui, el o ascunde sub limba lui.

verses.geez: ወሊሳዩ፡ ውስተ፡ ከርሡ፡ ትትገፈታዕ፡ ወያስተጋብእ፡ ማዕከለ፡ ጕርዔሁ።
verses.translation: though he will not spare it, and will not leave it, but will keep it in the midst of his throat:

translations.lxx: though he will not spare it, and will not leave it, but will keep it in the midst of his throat:
translations.kjv: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
translations.ron: Dacă o tine în gură şi nu o scuipă, dacă o mestecă în cerul gurii,

verses.geez: ወኢትክል፡ ትርድኦ፡ ወሕምዘ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ታሕተ፡ ከናፍሪሁ።
verses.translation: yet he shall not at all be able to help himself; the gall of an asp is in his belly.

translations.lxx: yet he shall not at all be able to help himself; the gall of an asp is in his belly.
translations.kjv: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.
translations.ron: Totuşi hrana lui în măruntaiele lui se strică şi se face în intestinele lui venin de năpârcă.

verses.geez: ብዕል፡ ዘይዘገብ፡ በዓመፃ፡ ይደመሰስ፡ ወያቴክሎ፡ መልአክ፡ ሞት፡ እምቤቱ።
verses.translation: His wealth unjustly collected shall be vomited up; a messenger of wrath shall drag him out of his house.

translations.lxx: His wealth unjustly collected shall be vomited up; a messenger of wrath shall drag him out of his house.
translations.kjv: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
translations.ron: Averea, pe care a înghiţit-o, acum o varsă; Dumnezeu i-o dă afară din pântece.

verses.geez: ወጠወሥኦ፡ ኅምዘ፡ አርዌ፡ ምድር፡ ወይቀትሎ፡ ልሳነ፡ አፍዖት።
verses.translation: And let him suck the poison of serpents, and let the serpent's tongue slay him.

translations.lxx: And let him suck the poison of serpents, and let the serpent's tongue slay him.
translations.kjv: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.
translations.ron: Venin de şarpe otrăvitor sugea. Limba de năpârcă îl omoară!

verses.geez: ወኢይሬኢ፡ እጕለ፡ መራዕይሁ፡ ወኢይውኅዝ፡ መዓር፡ ወቅብዕ፡ ወኢይፀምድ፡ ምዕረ፡ ወካዕበ።
verses.translation: Let him not see the milk of the pastures, nor the supplies of honey and butter.

translations.lxx: Let him not see the milk of the pastures, nor the supplies of honey and butter.
translations.kjv: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
translations.ron: El nu va mai vedea pâraiele de proaspăt untdelemn, valurile de miere şi de smântână.

verses.geez: በከንቱ፡ ወበበክ፡ ሠርኀ፡ ብዕሎ፡ ዘኢይጥዕም፡ እምኔሁ፡ ከመ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ዘኢይትሔየከ፡ ወኢይትወሐጥ።
verses.translation: He has laboured unprofitably and in vain, for wealth of which he shall not taste: it is as a lean thing, unfit for food, which he cannot swallow.

translations.lxx: He has laboured unprofitably and in vain, for wealth of which he shall not taste: it is as a lean thing, unfit for food, which he cannot swallow.
translations.kjv: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.
translations.ron: Dă îndărăt ce-a câştigat şi nu se mai foloseşte de câştig şi de roadele negustoriei sale nu se mai bucură.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አንሐለ፡ አብያተ፡ ድኩማን፡ ብዙኀ፡ ወበርበረ፡ ማኅፈደ፡ ወኢያግብኦ።
verses.translation: For he has broken down the houses of many mighty men: and he has plundered an habitation, though he built it not.

translations.lxx: For he has broken down the houses of many mighty men: and he has plundered an habitation, though he built it not.
translations.kjv: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
translations.ron: Pentru că a asuprit fără milă pe săraci şi a furat o casă, în loc să o zidească.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ዘይሣሃሎ፡ እምንዋዩ፡ ወኢያደምዕ፡ ፍትወቶ።
verses.translation: There is no security to his possessions; he shall not be saved by his desire.

translations.lxx: There is no security to his possessions; he shall not be saved by his desire.
translations.kjv: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
translations.ron: El nu va cunoaşte pacea lăuntrică şi el nu va scăpa nimic din toate câte preţuieşte.

verses.geez: ወአልቦ፡ ተረፍ፡ ለብዕሉ፡ ወበእንተዝ፡ ኢትሠምር፡ ሠናይቱ።
verses.translation: There is nothing remaining of his provisions; therefore his goods shall not flourish.

translations.lxx: There is nothing remaining of his provisions; therefore his goods shall not flourish.
translations.kjv: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
translations.ron: Nimic nu scapă de lăcomia lui, de aceea înflorirea lui nu va ţine deloc.

verses.geez: አመ፡ ይቤ፡ ሠለጥኩ፡ አሜሃ፡ ይትመነደብ፡ ወይመጽኦ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሕማም፡ ዘያጸግባ፡ ለከርሡ።
verses.translation: But when he shall seem to be just satisfied, he shall be straitened; and all distress shall come upon him.

translations.lxx: But when he shall seem to be just satisfied, he shall be straitened; and all distress shall come upon him.
translations.kjv: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
translations.ron: Când bogăţia lui va fi la culme, tulburarea îl va apuca deodată şi toate loviturile nenorocirii vor cădea în capul lui.

verses.geez: ወይትዌሰክ፡ መቅሠፍተ፡ መዓቱ፡ ወጥተግህ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ዘያሐምሞ።
verses.translation: If by any means he would fill his belly, let God send upon him the fury of wrath; let him bring a torrent of pains upon him.

translations.lxx: If by any means he would fill his belly, let God send upon him the fury of wrath; let him bring a torrent of pains upon him.
translations.kjv: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.
translations.ron: Când va fi gata să-şi sature pântecele, Dumnezeu va dezlănţui asupră-i urgia mâniei Sale şi va ploua cu săgeţi peste el.

verses.geez: ወኢያመስጥ፡ እምእደ፡ ኲናት፡ ወይበረብሮ፡ ቀስተ፡ ብርት።
verses.translation: And he shall by no means escape from the power of the sword; let the brazen bow wound him.

translations.lxx: And he shall by no means escape from the power of the sword; let the brazen bow wound him.
translations.kjv: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.
translations.ron: Dacă va scăpa de platoşa de fier, îl va străpunge arcul de aramă.

verses.geez: ወየኃልፍ፡ ሐፅ፡ ውስተ፡ ሥጋሁ፡ ወያንሶሱ፡ እኩይ፡ ውስተ፡ ነፍስቱ፡ ወላዕሌሁ፡ ዘያደነግዖ።
verses.translation: And let the arrow pierce through his body; and let the stars be against his dwelling-place: let terrors come upon him.

translations.lxx: And let the arrow pierce through his body; and let the stars be against his dwelling-place: let terrors come upon him.
translations.kjv: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.
translations.ron: O săgeată îi iese din spate, o alta i s-a înfipt în ficaţi şi spaimele morţii îl sfârşesc.

verses.geez: ወይጸንሖ፡ ኵሉ፡ ጽልመት፡ ወይበልዖ፡ እሳት፡ ዘእንደደ፡ ወይትጋየዖ፡ ጎረ፡ ቤቱ።
verses.translation: And let all darkness wait for him: a fire that burns not out shall consume him; and let a stranger plague his house.

translations.lxx: And let all darkness wait for him: a fire that burns not out shall consume him; and let a stranger plague his house.
translations.kjv: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
translations.ron: Toată neagra pieire ameninţă comorile pe care le-a adunat; un foc care arde neaprins îl mistuie pe oricine va mai rămâne din cortul lui.

verses.geez: ወከሠተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ጌጋዮ፡ ወምድርኒ፡ ኢትነሥኦ።
verses.translation: And let the heaven reveal his iniquities, and the earth rise up against him.

translations.lxx: And let the heaven reveal his iniquities, and the earth rise up against him.
translations.kjv: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
translations.ron: Cerurile vor dezveli fărădelegea lui şi pământul i se va ridica împotrivă.

verses.geez: ወሞት፡ ይስሕባ፡ ለቤቱ፡ ለዝሉፉ፡ ወትመጽኦ፡ ዕለተ፡ መንሱት።
verses.translation: Let destruction bring his house to an end; let a day of wrath come upon him.

translations.lxx: Let destruction bring his house to an end; let a day of wrath come upon him.
translations.kjv: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
translations.ron: Năpraznică revărsare de ape va mătura casa lui şi apele vor curge în ziua dumnezeieştii mânii.

verses.geez: ዝውእቱ፡ መክፈልቱ፡ ለብእሲ፡ ኃጥእ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወንዋዩሂ፡ ዘአጥረየ፡ እምኀበ፡ ፈጣሪሁ።
verses.translation: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and the possession of his goods appointed him by the all-seeing God.

translations.lxx: This is the portion of an ungodly man from the Lord, and the possession of his goods appointed him by the all-seeing God.
translations.kjv: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
translations.ron: Aceasta este partea hărăzită de Dumnezeu omului nelegiuit, aceasta este moştenirea pe care el o primeşte de la Domnul".
